description: End-to-end page redesign straight into Claude Design. Runs the draft-ui-redesign skill to audit a page and produce its self-contained generation prompt, then uses that prompt to build the redesign as a Claude Design artifact (the Artifact tool's Design type) — no copy-pasting between tools. Use when the user says "redesign this page in Claude Design", "take this screen through Claude Design", "draft and design the redesign", or runs /redesign-in-claude with a route or file. Claude-only: it targets Claude Design exclusively, never Stitch, v0, Lovable, or Figma Make.
